text:
Carmen H.: Short note from usability review — users got tripped up by mixed labels: global nav uses `Help`, the right-hand docs panel header says `Docs Hub`, and CTAs vary between `Open docs` and `Open help`. We should pick one surface lexicon. Noah D.: Seen this in support tickets. New customers ask where tutorials live. We need consistency so links don't promise different things. Liam (design): My proposal: keep global nav as `Help` for discoverability, rename panel header to `Console help` and use `Open in panel` for in-app CTAs, `View docs` when taking them offsite. Keeps things concise and scannable. Izzy M.: From infra/analytics we currently emit help_nav_click, docs_hub_open, docs_external_open. If we update copy we'll want a mapping and a short-lived alias shim so dashboards don't break. I can draft that. docbot: New recommendation doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/help-harmonize (author: @Liam (design)) :spiral_notepad: Carmen H.: Accessibility nit: the toggle button reads only "Button" for screen reader and there's no visible focus when the panel opens. Small ARIA patch suggested: ```

Console help: guides and API reference

``` Noah D.: Also deep-link behavior is inconsistent. Clicking in-app anchors (e.g., docs.redwood.ai/#batching) opens a new tab instead of focusing the panel. Users expect the panel to open to that section if content exists. Can we prefer panel deep-link and fallback to external? Liam (design): UX flow: 1) intercept anchor click, 2) attempt panel.deepLink(anchor), 3) if not available, open external. When deep-linking, briefly highlight the target heading and show a `Back to app` link. I'll add mocks. Izzy M.: Implementation note: we can parse the anchor fragment and call window.postMessage({type: 'HELP_OPEN', anchor}) to the shell. We'll emit analytics event `help_deeplink` with {anchor, mode}. Add feature flag help_panel_deeplink for rollout. Carmen H.: Microcopy tweak: change nav tooltip to `Help (guides & API)` and button label stays `Help`. In the panel header use `Console help` and in-panel CTA `Open in panel`. External links remain `View full docs`. Noah D.: Agree. Also ensure onboarding tour strings are updated so new users hear the same terms. Liam (design): I'll update Figma and the copy deck, include the highlight animation and the `Back to app` microcopy. PR with updated accessibility checklist coming later today. Izzy M.: I'll own the analytics migration plan: event aliasing + small shim returning legacy event names. Will add unit tests for deeplink fallback and aria-expanded state. Carmen H.: Can someone file a short RFC in #product-ship with owners and rollout steps (feature flag + event mapping) by EOD tomorrow? Noah D.: I'll file it and tag @Liam @Izzy. Liam (design): noted. Izzy M.: noted. Carmen H.: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
